admission.justification: The bound crosses the lane preview and the existing viewer’s destination lists: an unbounded new file can dominate the review, while a continuation sent to the wrong filter opens another file and hides the omitted evidence. The exact-file continuation keeps the cap from becoming accidental loss of the reviewable remainder.

applicability: Added text-file previews in the review reading column’s Code without invariant lane, including unexplained and unknown-attribution destinations.
conditions: Apply the 30-line cap only when the recorded before side is absent and the supplied after text has more than 30 lines.
Supply the first 30 text lines to the inline diff and state the remaining supplied line count in the continuation control.
A final newline terminates the last text line and contributes no extra line.
The continuation requests that lane file’s exact path in the filter whose lane destination lists it.
At 30 lines or fewer draw the complete supplied after text and no remaining-line continuation.
exclusions: Modified or removed text files do not receive this added-file cap.
Non-text files and unavailable text keep their separately named states rather than an invented text preview.
The full change-set viewer’s diff is not capped by this inline preview policy.
Reader-line pixel stability, browser visual acceptance, read scheduling and file-pick semantics are separate obligations.
